decisions.rationale: One row per scheduled flight leg, identified by date (year, month, day), sched_dep_time, carrier, flight number, origin, and dest; all eight columns have null_rate 0.0 so the grain is enforceable, and a human should measure uniqueness against the warehouse before approval.
duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across 166158 rows, so no deduplication step is proposed.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta carry is_airbyte_metadata true and describe the ingestion tool, not the flights, so all three are dropped.

dep_time and dep_delay share null_rate 0.029388 (4883 rows), the signature of cancelled flights; an is_cancelled boolean is derived so consumers can filter deliberately instead of silently losing rows.
arr_time (null_rate 0.0307), arr_delay and air_time (null_rate 0.032981 each) stay nullable; nulls reflect cancelled or diverted flights and no rows are dropped or imputed.
tailnum has null_rate 0.009154 (1521 nulls); a missing tail number does not invalidate the flight record, so nulls are retained.
All DECIMAL(38,9) columns show exclusively integral samples and integral min/max bounds (e.g. flight in [1.0, 8500.0], distance in [80.0, 4983.0]), so each is cast to INTEGER.
Every time_hour sample is ISO-8601 shaped (e.g. 2013-01-01T10:00:00Z) with null_rate 0.0, supporting a strict VARCHAR to TIMESTAMP cast.

purpose: silver_nyc_flights is the cleaned flight-level table for NYC-origin flights in January through June 2013, one row per scheduled flight leg, typed and stripped of ingestion metadata. It feeds delay analysis, carrier performance metrics, and downstream gold aggregations.
usage: Read one row per scheduled flight leg on the grain (year, month, day, sched_dep_time, carrier, flight, origin, dest). dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time are null for flights that did not operate or complete; filter on is_cancelled = false (or require non-null arr_delay) deliberately before computing delay statistics. Time-of-day columns use HHMM integer encoding (e.g. 517 means 05:17); time_hour is the scheduled departure hour as a proper TIMESTAMP.
limitations: Covers only 2013 months 1 through 6 (year has a single distinct value 2013; month spans 1.0 to 6.0). About 2.9% of rows (null_rate 0.029388 on dep_time) are cancellations and about 3.3% (null_rate 0.032981 on arr_delay and air_time) lack arrival metrics; these nulls are retained, not imputed. tailnum is missing on 0.9% of rows. HHMM time columns are kept as integers rather than reconstructed into full timestamps, and the declared grain has not yet been measured against the warehouse.
